description: Four units whose lossless channel set stores its samples in 18 bits, and the DTS:X word after the band data, which is not looked for.

crosscheck.decode_error: 18-bit XLL storage resolution is not implemented

skip.ffprobe_bitrate: ffmpeg's lossless decoder sets the bit rate to 0 (dca_xll.c: avctx->bit_rate = 0), so ffprobe lists none
skip.ffprobe_profile: ffmpeg names the lossless profile when its decoder has decoded a frame (dca_xll.c), which it does not here, so ffprobe names the core's
skip.decode: ffmpeg's decoder implements storage widths of 16, 20 and 24 bits only, and stops before the DTS:X word (dca_xll.c: '18-bit XLL storage resolution')
